mechanism: Chloroquine may increase valproate levels through inhibition of hepatic metabolism and potential displacement from protein binding, while valproate may increase chloroquine concentrations, increasing risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor valproate and chloroquine levels; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; assess for signs of valproate toxicity (tremor, ataxia) and chloroquine toxicity (visual disturbances, myopathy).
